home.seoDescription: Venus — a photographic aesthetics evaluation system powered by adversarial multi-agent review, with single-frame, joint-series and comparative evaluations.

hero.title: Venus
hero.subtitle: Photographic Aesthetics Evaluation
hero.tagline: Professional photographic aesthetics evaluation powered by adversarial multi-agent review
hero.lede: From a single photo to a whole series, Venus proposes, challenges and arbitrates to deliver scores, critique, actionable advice and verifiable evidence.
hero.sheetNoteText: See the relationships between photos first, then form a judgment.
hero.frameLandscapeAlt: Sample landscape photograph of mountains and clouds
hero.frameForestAlt: Sample photograph of light and shadow in a forest
hero.frameWaterAlt: Sample photograph of water surface texture

modes.title: Choose an evaluation mode
modes.description: From the close reading of a single frame to series narrative and side-by-side comparison, pick the mode that matches the question you are working on.

single.title: Single review
single.description: Assess composition, light, subject, technical execution and visual impact of one work, with a full verdict and actionable advice.

joint.title: Joint series review
joint.description: Treat 2–10 photos as one series and assess overall narrative, visual consistency, rhythm and completeness.

compare.title: Comparative review
compare.description: Compare 2–10 photos under one standard to get a ranking, scores, a difference summary and the evidence behind each judgment.

process.title: Not a one-off answer, but an evidence-based aesthetic debate.
process.lede: Three reviewing roles examine each work from different positions, so scores withstand challenge and advice carries back into the next shoot and edit.

genre.title: Genre identification
genre.description: Identify the photographic genre to select the assessment dimensions and context that fit the work.

proposal.title: Proposer's initial review
proposal.description: Read the photo and form dimension scores, critique and preliminary advice.

challenge.title: Critic's challenge
challenge.description: Check the initial review for bias, thin evidence and inconsistent scoring.

verdict.title: Arbitrator's verdict
verdict.description: Weigh both arguments into a final score, ranking or series conclusion.

sample.title: Not just a score — how the judgment is formed.
sample.lede: Light leads the eye deep into the frame and the repeating trunks build a steady rhythm; yet the highlight on the right ends the gaze a beat too early, weakening spatial continuation.
sample.imageAlt: Sample evaluation of a forest light photograph

strength.detail: Clear direction of light; layers and rhythm support each other.

improve.detail: Hold back the edge highlights so the viewing path lingers longer.

basis.detail: An overall judgment across composition, light, subject and visual impact.

cta.title: Start with one photograph.
cta.lede: Upload your work and see the full evaluation — from initial review and challenge to final verdict.

single.seoDescription: Use the Venus multi-agent system to assess composition, light, technique and visual impact of a single photograph.
single.heroLede: Put the work back at the centre of viewing — from initial review and challenge to verdict, get scores, evidence and directions to improve.
single.inputIntro: Choose a photography genre and upload a photo. The system will assess composition, light, subject, technical execution and visual impact.

groupJoint.seoDescription: Use Venus to run a joint series review of 2–10 photographs, with scores, analysis and verifiable evidence.
groupJoint.heroLede: Treat your photos as one series and analyse overall narrative, visual consistency, rhythm and completeness.
groupJoint.inputIntro: Upload 2–10 photos and arrange their order. The system will focus on the relationships between photos, not just score them one by one.
groupJoint.minImagesError: Please select 2–10 photos before starting the review

groupCompare.seoDescription: Use Venus to compare 2–10 photographs side by side, with scores, analysis and verifiable evidence.
groupCompare.heroLede: Let every photo be seen under the same frame and the same standard — get a ranking, scores and the evidence behind each difference.
groupCompare.inputIntro: Upload 2–10 photos. The system will compare each work under a unified standard — order does not affect the assessment.
groupCompare.minImagesError: Please select 2–10 photos before starting the review
groupCompare.missingText: Photo removed from current selection; re-upload to preview

focusCompare.title: Focus Compare
focusCompare.intro: Pick two photos to compare their score gap, strengths and limitations at identical size. Click either image to enter immersive comparison.
focusCompare.deltaBarsAria: Overall score comparison of the two photos
focusCompare.deltaNote: Trace each difference against the strengths and limitations on both sides; the overall score is no substitute for the photos themselves and the written evidence.
